name: web-design-guidelines
title_zh: 按 Web 界面规范逐条审查你的 UI 代码
tagline_zh: 说一句「检查我的界面」，它就把按钮、焦点、触控、语义逐条过一遍。不是泛泛而谈，是拿着 Vercel 的规范清单挑刺。
tagline_en: Say "review my UI" and it walks your buttons, focus, touch targets, and semantics against a real checklist—not.
desc_en: Review UI code for Web Interface Guidelines compliance. Use when asked to "review my UI", "check accessibility", "audit design", "review UX", or "check my site against best practices".
why_zh: 它把散落的 Web 界面最佳实践固化成可执行的审查流程，每次输出都对应具体规范条目，而不是凭感觉给建议。
why_en: It turns scattered UI best practices into a repeatable audit—every finding maps to a concrete guideline, not a vibe.
limit_zh: 只审代码不审视觉稿；需要你提供组件源码或页面文件，纯截图或设计稿它无法运行。产物是问题清单，不含自动修复补丁。
limit_en: Code only—no screenshots or design files. You must supply source. Output is a findings list, not auto-fixes.
